comparison.eq: exact string equality for the unique key=value token; identical duplicate values are accepted, conflicting values or a simultaneous bare key are ERROR
comparison.one-of: actual unique key=value token must equal one member of the ordered expected list; list is encoded as safe token values joined by |; first member is preferred but every listed member is compliant; adapter does not infer whether the preferred value is supported by the running kernel
comparison.present: exact bare token presence; any key=value form for the same key makes the observation ambiguous and ERROR

error_value_contract: Every ERROR wire value is a stable <domain>:<reason> code; literal - is reserved for non-error absence such as NOT_FOUND.

observation.binary_safety: Raw NUL is rejected as cmdline:invalid-bytes before Bash line parsing.
observation.tokenization: ASCII shell whitespace into exact tokens using bash read -a

one_of_expected_encoding.member_syntax: same safe nonempty token syntax as eq expected values
